headline: Names a Wisconsin post office building in De Pere after Corporal Justin D. Ross.
what_it_does: This law gives an official name to the Postal Service building at 123 South 9th Street in De Pere, Wisconsin. The building will be called the Corporal Justin D. Ross Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 9, 2014.
